title: PDEA destroys P162.5-M illegal drugs, expired medicines in Zamboanga Sur

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR, Philippines — Anti-narcotics operatives on Thursday destroyed P162.52 million worth of confiscated illegal drugs and regulated medicines in Aurora, Zamboanga del Sur, in a bid to prevent the seized contraband from being recycled back into the streets. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in Zamboanga Peninsula (PDEA-9) led the thermal destruction of P162,524,439.09 worth of evidence at the Libertad Power and Energy Corporation facility on Nov. 12. The bulk of the destroyed contraband consisted of 23.62 kilograms of meth, locally known as “shabu,” valued at P160,608,179.32, and 9.13 kilograms of marijuana worth P1,096,078.83.
